Therefore the named sign_halfline helper and the cited leaf replays do perform the compactification implicitly; when the input pairing has degree seven this is the asserted Q. The NEGATIVE branch's mapping x/(1-x) is correspondingly appropriate. No general checker fault follows from the cited source.
